summary: This was an open race because Gov. Mark Gordon was term-limited. Eric Barlow (Republican) defeated Rebecca Bextel (Constitution Party) and Ken Casner (Democrat).

candidates.name: Eric Barlow
candidates.bio: Eric Barlow is a Wyoming state senator from Gillette. He won the 2026 Republican nomination for governor.

positions.summary: Says he delivered on property tax relief and lists energy expansion among his priorities.
Says he supported expanding telehealth, stabilizing rural hospitals and reducing regulatory burdens on doctors and clinics.
Supports local control and parental involvement in schools, and backs vocational and trades training.
Supports coal, oil, gas and uranium production and says Wyoming should decide its own energy future.
Describes himself as "firmly pro-life" with a legislative record supporting protections for the unborn.

factCheckNote: Winner matches AP-sourced tally (MultiState governors tracker, updated Nov 4, 35 of 36 races called)
